observations.why: Speaker labels a subordinate by first name, enacting a reporting hierarchy where Quill delivers to Xena.

evidence.quote:
We verified the calibration against the June reference plates and it
holds across the full observing band.

observations.why: Quill reports verification results upward to the authority who requested calibration, performing deferential information delivery within a ranked structure.
Xena condenses Quill's report into a structured summary, re-presenting the hierarchical reporting act in her own voice as the authority receiving it.
